title: PATCH /api/projects/:id/parking-lot/:pid — update or archive parking lot item
description: Update a parking lot item's title, description, or archive/unarchive it.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH requires auth and project ownership
archived=true sets archived_at, archived=false clears it

steps.details: updateParkingLotSchema = z.object({ title: z.string().min(1).max(500).optional(), description: z.string().max(2000).optional(), archived: z.boolean().optional() }). Find item WHERE id = pid AND project_id. Update fields. If archived = true, set archived_at = NOW(). If archived = false, set archived_at = null. Return 200.
Archive item — verify archived_at set. Unarchive — verify archived_at null.
